description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the class ImmutableJsonInt, verifying its immutability, equality, hashCode consistency, and behavior when converting to other types, as well as its classification as a number in JSON context.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonIntTest
classes.description: Test class for ImmutableJsonInt, verifying its properties and behaviors across different scenarios.

classes.name: ParameterizedTests
classes.description: Nested class within ImmutableJsonIntTest that runs parameterized tests over various integer values.

methods.name: intValues
methods.description: Provides a collection of integer values for parameterized tests, including edge cases like Integer.MIN_VALUE and Integer.MAX_VALUE, as well as 0 and 1337.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test instance of ImmutableJsonInt with the current parameter before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that ImmutableJsonInt instances are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of equals and hashCode methods, and consistency with related JSON value classes like ImmutableJsonLong and ImmutableJsonDouble.

methods.name: jsonIntEqualsJsonLongIfSameValue
methods.description: Checks that ImmutableJsonInt equals ImmutableJsonLong when they hold the same numeric value.

methods.name: jsonIntHasSameHashCodeAsJsonLongIfSameValue
methods.description: Ensures that hash codes match between ImmutableJsonInt and ImmutableJsonLong for identical values.

methods.name: jsonIntEqualsJsonDoubleIfSameValue
methods.description: Checks equality between ImmutableJsonInt and ImmutableJsonDouble when values are equal.

methods.name: jsonIntHasSameHashCodeAsJsonDoubleIfSameValue
methods.description: Ensures hashCode consistency between ImmutableJsonInt and ImmutableJsonDouble for same values.

methods.name: getValueReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that getValue() returns the original integer value.

methods.name: asIntReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that asInt() returns the integer value.

methods.name: asLongReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that asLong() returns the integer value as long.

methods.name: asDoubleReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that asDouble() returns the integer value as double.

methods.name: toStringReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that toString() returns the string representation of the integer value.

methods.name: isNotNull
methods.description: Confirms that the JSON value is not null.

methods.name: isNotBoolean
methods.description: Confirms that the JSON value is not a boolean.

methods.name: isNumber
methods.description: Verifies that the value is identified as a number.

methods.name: isInt
methods.description: Verifies that the value is identified as an integer.

methods.name: isLong
methods.description: Verifies that the value is identified as a long.

methods.name: isDouble
methods.description: Verifies that the value is identified as a double.

methods.name: isNotString
methods.description: Confirms that the value is not a string.

methods.name: isNotObject
methods.description: Confirms that the value is not a JSON object.

methods.name: isNotArray
methods.description: Confirms that the value is not a JSON array.

methods.name: tryToGetAsBoolean
methods.description: Ensures that attempting to retrieve the value as boolean throws an UnsupportedOperationException.

methods.name: tryToGetAsString
methods.description: Ensures that attempting to retrieve the value as string throws an exception.

methods.name: tryToGetAsObject
methods.description: Ensures that attempting to retrieve the value as object throws an exception.

methods.name: tryToGetAsArray
methods.description: Ensures that attempting to retrieve the value as array throws an exception.
